name: Voting Engagement
summary: Scores users based on how varied their wallet-linked votes are.
description:
### What it does
Measures the variety in each user's wallet-linked voting history.

### How it works
- Users and their wallets come from DeepID.
- The wallet collections file links each wallet to one or more voting collections.
- The vote history file groups votes by collection.
- Using a wider range of ratings increases the score.
- Repeating the same rating lowers the score.
- Scores range from 0 to 1.

### Inputs
Upload a vote history CSV and a wallet collections CSV. The second file links each voting `collection_id` to a wallet `address`.

### Outputs
- CSV file with `did` and `voting_engagement`.
- JSON file with vote distribution details for each user.

inputs.label: Vote history (CSV)
inputs.description: Upload a CSV file of votes. Each row must include `collection_id`, `question_id`, and an `answer` of `skip` or `1` to `10`.

columns.description: Vote answer: `skip` or a rating from `1` to `10`.
Optional date and time when the vote was created.
Optional date and time when the vote was last updated.
ID of the question or proposal.
Optional balance saved with the vote.
Optional stake saved with the vote.
Voting collection used to group votes before linking them to users.

inputs.label: Wallet collections (CSV)
inputs.description: Map each voting `collection_id` to a wallet `address`. Reputo uses this file to link votes to users.

columns.description: Voting collection used to group votes in the vote history file.
Wallet address linked to the `collection_id`. Matching is not case-sensitive.
Optional blockchain name, such as Ethereum or Cardano. It is not used for matching.

outputs.label: Voting engagement (CSV)
outputs.description: One row per user with their final voting engagement score.

columns.description: User score from 0 to 1, based on the variety of ratings used.

outputs.label: Voting engagement details (JSON)
outputs.description: Vote distribution details for each user.
